rhea:23124.reason: Rhea directional record for Rubisco carboxylation: D-ribulose 1,5-bisphosphate + CO2 + H2O => 2 (2R)-3-phosphoglycerate + 2 H(+)

carbon_source_policy: CO2 is the only admissible carbon source for a Cannabis plant; every other carbon-containing reactant is an explicit external-carbon-source blocker until connected to CO2.
claim_boundary: Reachability is based on one-to-one structural RDKit mappings and exact identity crosswalks. It is not isotope tracing, enzyme validation, or proof of in-vivo biosynthesis; all unresolved reasons are retained.
